body.name: Rank-respecting joint moment confidence region
body.construction: \(E_n=\{\theta\in\Theta_n:n(\widehat z-z(\theta))^{\prime}\widehat V^{-1}(\widehat z-z(\theta))\le\chi^2_{q_z,1-\alpha}\}\), using a fixed positive-definite regularization of \(\widehat V\) on its vanishing-probability failure event. Thus every element of \(E_n\) indexes an admissible observed-panel law through \(\theta\mapsto P_\theta\).
